target.title: Pause Android realtime relay capture during PTT
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android Talk Mode could keep realtime relay microphone capture running while a push-to-talk command started Android `SpeechRecognizer` capture. That allowed the same user speech to be processed by both the realtime relay path and the PTT `chat.send` path, and could also create microphone resource contention between `AudioRecord` and the system recognizer.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change gives PTT explicit ownership over the realtime relay capture lifecycle:

- PTT begin pauses realtime capture/append jobs and waits for them to close before starting `SpeechRecognizer`.
- If the realtime session finishes connecting while PTT is active, it records the relay as paused instead of opening `AudioRecord`.
- PTT stop/cancel and PTT chat completion resume the paused relay only when the same capture id owns the pause and no newer PTT capture is active.
- Stop/close cleanup clears paused relay ownership so stale sessions cannot resume later.

The relay session itself is not closed just to run PTT; only local capture/append jobs are paused and resumed.

## User Impact

Talk Mode users should no longer get duplicate responses when a gateway invokes `talk.ptt.start` / `talk.ptt.once` while realtime Talk Mode is already active. The app also avoids overlapping realtime `AudioRecord` capture with Android's `SpeechRecognizer` during PTT.

## Evidence

- `env JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home GRADLE_OPTS='-Dorg.gradle.java.home=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home' node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.voice.TalkModeManagerTest` - passed
- `env JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home GRADLE_OPTS='-Dorg.gradle.java.home=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home' node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs :app:runKtlintCheckOverMainSourceSet` - passed
- `env JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home GRADLE_OPTS='-Dorg.gradle.java.home=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home' node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs :app:runKtlintCheckOverTestSourceSet` - passed
- `git diff --check` - passed

Autoreview was started during development and its accepted PTT lifecycle findings were addressed; final autoreview rerun was skipped at maintainer request to open the PR immediately.
